# R3 job tables (generated by gen/r3gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, runner knobs, regtimeline), the exact tool command and the frozen
predictions (quantity = value [hypothesis] label).  The tool is `$T` (~/sgxfive-test-r1), staged programs `$S`, the
work directory `$W`.  `set`: control, heldout, repeat, replicate.  `tables/` is the runner's input; this is a view.
P: a hex value (render_pb_pages), `-` (not touched), or a cell the RUNNER derives from kept output: `B:G` the midpoint of
the bracket of group G, `L:G[:off]` / `F:G[:off]` the last raise / first silent thr0 of group G (+ off) + 0x22.
Knobs: `ctl:R|N` = a control with its expected raise (a different reading stops the session), `obs:G` = the job's
observation (raise, none, void) is recorded in group G, `cal:G` = a calibration (page need, partial renders recorded),
`gate:N` = more than N partial renders at the calibration ends the stage, `fit:G` = the row is skipped if 2 thr0 is above
the page need of the group's calibration (the second run cannot reach thr0).  Stage-level predictions (`@name`) have no job.

## g-da: 27 jobs, 27 conditions

```
g-da (Q230, depth at w != 1): the threshold ladder.  Offline FIT (post hoc, closing3/geometry/exp-
geometry-r3.md): E783's six words
and E782's four kept vertices are all matched by ONE family, "round |z RZ(1/w)| away from zero iff
its fraction exceeds t", t between
0.3655 and 0.4667 (T26: t = 3/8, T27: t = 7/16; K23, z cut to 23 bits, also fits), round to
nearest (D1) and the others miss one word
or more.  The fit rests on ONE word (t4-m2p6-3); 257 models were tried.  z/w in (-1, -0.5] keeps
the sum 0.5 + 0.5 q exact, so the
stored word is a function of the rounded product alone.  Controls (6, each can fail): the two R2
controls, repeats of t4-m2p6-3 and
t4-m6p1-7 (the first one is the fit's own word: another word stops the reading), w = 2 and 0.5
(exact products).  Held out (21):
five cells below t (fraction 0.02-0.10, 0.30-0.36: down), four above (0.47-0.498: up, D1 down),
two above one half (up), ten inside
the interval in five bins of two (T26 up from 0.375, T27 from 0.4375).  H-thr holds iff the 11
outside cells read as frozen and the
10 inside cells are monotone in the fraction; T26 or T27 is named only if one is right 10 of 10
inside.  A non-monotone inside row
refutes the threshold family; the simulator then keeps refusing z != 0.  Each W is used at most
three times.
```

## g-db: 16 jobs, 16 conditions

```
g-db (Q230): sign, magnitude and the sum.  The threshold family of g-da is asked, on the cells it
can still be wrong, whether
"up" means away from zero (T26 / T27: the fraction of |p|) or toward +infinity (T26d / T27d: the
floor fraction; the same on
every negative product, so g-da cannot tell), and how the sum 0.5 + 0.5 q' is rounded where it is
not exact: nearest even (rn),
toward zero (rz), half up (rh).  Six pairs with z > 0 and z/w in [0.5, 1) (the sum ties when q' is
odd): 7 rules x 3 sums = 21
labels, the generator keeps the six pairs that tell the most label pairs apart (greedy).  Six
pairs with |z/w| in (0.25, 0.5),
three of each sign: the product at its own float32 precision against the product kept on the 2^-23
grid of the sum (D1, D5, T26,
T27), K23 and the sums.  Four pairs with w next to 1 (E783's "near w = 1"): z = -0.75 (or the
nearest z that separates), w = 1 + 2^-23, 1 - 2^-23 (E783 named 1 - 2^-24, whose RZ reciprocal is
exactly 1: no rule can differ), 1.5, 1.0000004,
eight rules.  No control job: the stage reads only cells that g-da's controls guard (the scorer
needs every pair to carry at least two
distinct frozen words); a held-out label is `consistent` only if it fits all 16 cells it is frozen
on.
```

## g-dc: 10 jobs, 10 conditions

```
g-dc (Q230): the viewport z words, `--blk 10=V --blk 11=V` (vp4, vp5).  E193 reads vp4 as the z
offset and vp5 as the z scale (both
0.5 by default); one slope never separated which is which, nor how the sum is rounded.
Candidates: VF (offset + scale x the
product to nearest, one rounding of the sum), VT (the scale product rounded first), VZ ((z scale)
rounded, times RZ(1/w)
rounded, then the sum), VS (the order swapped).  Four jobs at w = 1: the default words written
explicitly (control: 0x3e800000),
offset 0.25 with scale 0.5, the swap, and scale 0.3 with offset 0.6 and a z where one and two
roundings of the sum differ; then
six at w != 1 with scale 0.3 chosen by the generator (greedy) to tell (z rhw) scale from (z scale)
rhw.  Depth stays inside [0, 1].
The product at w != 1 is rounded to nearest in every candidate (D1): g-da decides that rule first,
so a miss at w != 1 is read
together with its result.
```

## g-c4: 10 jobs, 10 conditions

```
g-c4 (Q210): the exact limit C at 2048x2048, 1500 vertices, plain 2048x2048 context.  E785
bracketed the last raising thr0 in (0xc0,
0x100): raise at P 0xe2, none at 0x122.  LT (a fit to 4096x4096 alone): the last raise is at thr0
<= floor(0x351 R / 32768) with R =
regions = ceil(W/32) ceil(H/16), i.e. thr0 0xd4 (C 0xf4) at 2048x2048, inside the bracket, a 1 in
64 hit on the exact cell.  Four
controls (R1's two at 4096, R2's two at 2048; knob ctl:R / ctl:N: a control that reads otherwise
stops the session), then six
bisect cells whose thr0 the RUNNER picks from the kept observations of the group (state file,
midpoint lo + (hi - lo) / 2, lo = the
highest raise, hi = the lowest silent above it; under LT the cells are 0xe0, 0xd0, 0xd8, 0xd4,
0xd6, 0xd5).  A void cell (no abort,
or the second run does not reach thr0) ends the bisect.  The scorer re-derives every pick and
flags one off the rule.  Verdict: the
exact flip at 0xd4/0xd5 = LT holds; any other exact flip refutes LT and is the measurement; two
flips refute the monotone form.
Side table in every job: H-last.
```

## g-d36: 6 jobs, 6 conditions

```
g-d36 (Q273): dword 36 of the control block against the 0x072c page count at the LAST abort.
H-last (fit post hoc on 49 kept jobs, 49
of 49, only two of them separating it from the peak and second-abort readings): the firmware
writes dword 36 = max(global page count
- 2, 0) at every abort and the last write stays; no abort reads 0.  E790 refuted "peak less 2" (13
of 15) and "first abort less 2" (8
of 15).  Six jobs, 1500 vertices, the knob only: 2048x2048 at thr0 0x60, 0x70, 0x90, 0xb0 (E785
had three aborts at 0x80 and 0xc0), 4096x4096
at 0x2c0 and 0x300 (E786's k-1500-0x300 had three).  The scorer prints per job the counts before
each abort, marks a job SEP when H-last's value differs
from the peak reading's or the second-abort reading's.  H-last holds iff every separating job fits
and at least 3
jobs separate; one miss in a separating job refutes it; fewer than 3 separating jobs: cannot tell.
The controls are g-c4's (the
session's): the scorer needs g-c4's four controls to pass.  Partial renders are expected 3 to 8 a
job; the stage stops on `job hung`.
```

## g-c6: 5 jobs, 5 conditions

```
g-c6 (Q210): context against target.  The render context is created for up to --max-width x --max-
height; R2's 2048x2048 jobs ran in a
2048x2048 context.  Here the same 2048x2048 target in a 4096x4096 context: a calibration at P
0x422, the two cells at g-c4's flip
(the runner reads g-c4's kept observations: the last raise L and the first silent F; a stage run
without g-c4's state skips them) and
thr0 0x100, 0x120.  H-target: the flip of g-c4 (L raises, F none, 0x100 and 0x120 none).
H-context: raise at every valid cell (the
4096 limit).  A page need other than 0x213 is reported and makes the cells a measurement.  Cells
with 2 thr0 above the need are skipped
by the runner (fit:c6) as void by construction.
```

## g-c5: 36 jobs, 36 conditions

```
g-c5 (Q210): three more targets, 1500 vertices, a plain context of the target's size, 12 jobs
each: a calibration at P 0x422, five
fixed cells (the ends of the affine-in-regions bracket and LT's flip pair; the runner skips a cell
whose 2 thr0 is above the page
need: void by construction), then up to six bisect cells whose thr0 the runner picks from the kept
observations of the target's group
(none run if the bracket is closed, absent or non-monotone).  Laws, frozen as formulas over the
MEASURED C(2048x2048) of g-c4: LT (one
point, from 4096x4096), and affine through the two exact points in regions, in the tail-pointer
side squared, in the macrotile area.
4096x2048 and 2048x4096 have equal regions (16384) and tail-pointer sides 128 and 256: different
limits there refute every law in
regions alone.  The scorer evaluates a law's predicted interval against the measured last-raise
interval.  The controls are
g-c4's.  Void cells (second run short of thr0) are expected above about half the page need; a law
whose flip lies there is
"not reached", not refuted.
```

## g-c7: 11 jobs, 11 conditions

```
g-c7 (Q210): another scene, LAST, hang-recovery class.  `--tri-full --vertices 1500` at 2048x2048:
the triangle covers the target.  The only
stage that tells scene from target (the 1350-vertex scene is a prefix of the 1500 one, so E774's
HP1 does not).  The calibration at P
0x422 is the gate: more than 3 partial renders and the stage ends after one job (E630 and E706 saw
`job hung` in long partial-render
sequences).  Otherwise: cells at g-c4's flip pair (last raise L, first silent F) and four around
it (L - 16, L - 4, F + 4, F + 16),
then up to four bisect cells picked by the runner.  H-target: the flip of g-c4; H-scene: another.
Cells with 2 thr0 above the
scene's own page need are skipped as void by construction.  The controls are g-c4's.
```
